ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point D is on the circumcircle of the equilateral triangle $\triangle ABC$, and $\angle DAC = 20^\circ$. What is the measure of $\angle ACD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\triangle ABC$ is an equilateral triangle,\\
it follows that $\angle BAC = \angle ACB = 60^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle BAD = \angle BAC + \angle DAC = 60^\circ + 20^\circ = 80^\circ$,\\
since quadrilateral ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral,\\
it follows that $\angle BCD = 180^\circ - \angle BAD = 180^\circ - 80^\circ = 100^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle ACD = \angle BCD - \angle ACB = 100^\circ - 60^\circ = \boxed{40^\circ}$.
